source_summary: Tall monochrome Chinese landscape scroll with layered monumental mountains, cliff terraces, small architectural clusters, pine groves, waterfalls or pale watercourses, rocky streambeds, and foreground pavilions. Calligraphy and seal at the upper right are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_left_sheer_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the towering upper-left mountain massif with flat-topped and jagged cliff faces, pale central rock planes, dark vertical scarps, and sparse crest vegetation. Exclude the calligraphy area and lower village terraces.
must_preserve: thin ink outlines defining the irregular summit silhouette
vertical cun texture strokes on the dark cliff walls
pale unwashed central rock planes
small dotted and bristled vegetation along the ridgelines
subtle layered wash transitions at cliff bases

motifs.name: upper_right_folded_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the rounded upper-right mountain with sweeping arched contour bands, striated rock texture, and a narrow tree-lined ledge across its lower middle.
must_preserve: long curved contour lines following the mountain folds
dry-brush striations and light ink washes
thin mist-softened outer edges
horizontal ledge line with tiny clustered pine strokes
dark accents in creases and ravines

motifs.name: middle_left_terrace_village
motifs.description: Isolate the compact village and pavilion cluster on stepped cliffs at middle left, including small roofed buildings, vertical rock walls, pine rows, and connecting terrace paths.
must_preserve: angular tiled roof geometry of the small buildings
stepped cliff outlines and cracked rock faces
dense vertical pine and shrub strokes around the terraces
fine path lines linking the structures
dark ink accents under eaves and cliff overhangs

motifs.name: central_pine_pavilion_ledge
motifs.description: Isolate the central ledge with tall leaning pines, a small pavilion or lookout structure, and the cliff platform beneath it.
must_preserve: slender pine trunks with sparse branching
needle clusters rendered as short dark strokes
small pavilion roof and posts on the ledge
flat cliff-top platform with dotted shrubs
vertical fissures descending from the ledge

motifs.name: right_ledge_house_and_rocky_stream
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side small house on a rocky ledge together with the adjacent boulder-strewn stream or ravine below it.
must_preserve: simple house with dark pitched roof and pale wall plane
curving bank line around the ledge
rounded boulders and angular rocks in the streambed
small shrub clusters beside the rocks
broken ink outlines suggesting shallow water channels

motifs.name: central_sheer_waterfall_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central pale precipice or waterfall-like vertical rock face descending from the mid-scroll ledge, including flanking dark fissures and rocky foot.
must_preserve: broad pale vertical central plane
long dry vertical lines suggesting falling water or sheer stone
dark flanking cracks and cliff edges
small rocks and broken ledges at the base
misty unpainted negative space around the descent

motifs.name: lower_left_bamboo_shrub_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left bank with bamboo-like stems, leafy shrubs, small rocks, and a sloping ground plane beside the water or misty open area.
must_preserve: fine bamboo stems and feathery leaves
rounded shrub masses made of dotted ink strokes
small outlined rocks at the bank edge
sloping contour lines of the ground
delicate dry-brush foliage texture

motifs.name: foreground_pines_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the lower foreground grove with large twisting pines and the open pavilion at bottom right, including trunks, branch canopies, roof, posts, and nearby low shrubs.
must_preserve: gnarled pine trunks with textured bark lines
flat spreading pine-needle clusters in dark ink
open pavilion roof with thin support posts
low shrubs and bushes behind the pavilion
soft ground contours and sparse foreground ink accents

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
